import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_layernorm_(x):
    R, C = x.shape
    # Allocate output in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate input tile in SBUF
    tile = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    # Copy input to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Compute mean over columns (axis=1)
    mean_tile = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    mean = nl.mean(tile, axis=[1], keepdims=True)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=mean_tile, src=mean)
    
    # Compute variance over columns (axis=1)
    var_tile = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    diff = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=diff, data1=tile, data2=mean_tile, op=nl.subtract)
    square = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=square, data1=diff, data2=diff, op=nl.multiply)
    var = nl.mean(square, axis=[1], keepdims=True)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=var_tile, src=var)
    
    # Add epsilon and take square root
    var_plus_eps = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=var_plus_eps, data=var_tile, op0=nl.add, operand0=1e-5)
    sqrt_var = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.activation(dst=sqrt_var, op=nl.sqrt, data=var_plus_eps)
    
    # Compute (x - mean) / sqrt(var + 1e-5)
    norm = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=norm, data1=diff, data2=sqrt_var, op=nl.divide)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=out, src=norm)
    return out

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_layernorm_(x):
    R, C = x.shape
    # Allocate output in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Loop over rows in chunks of 128
    for i in nl.affine_range(0, R, 128):
        # Define chunk size
        chunk_size = min(128, R - i)
        # Allocate input tile in SBUF for current chunk
        tile = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        # Copy input chunk to SBUF
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[i:i+chunk_size, :])
        
        # Compute mean over columns (axis=1)
        mean_tile = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        mean = nl.mean(tile, axis=[1], keepdims=True)
        nisa.tensor_copy(dst=mean_tile, src=mean)
        
        # Compute variance over columns (axis=1)
        var_tile = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        diff = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=diff, data1=tile, data2=mean_tile, op=nl.subtract)
        square = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=square, data1=diff, data2=diff, op=nl.multiply)
        var = nl.mean(square, axis=[1], keepdims=True)
        nisa.tensor_copy(dst=var_tile, src=var)
        
        # Add epsilon and take square root
        var_plus_eps = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=var_plus_eps, data=var_tile, op0=nl.add, operand0=1e-5)
        sqrt_var = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        nisa.activation(dst=sqrt_var, op=nl.sqrt, data=var_plus_eps)
        
        # Compute reciprocal of sqrt(var)
        inv_sqrt_var = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        nisa.reciprocal(dst=inv_sqrt_var, data=sqrt_var)
        
        # Compute (x - mean) / sqrt(var)
        scaled_diff = nl.ndarray((chunk_size, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
        nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=scaled_diff, data1=diff, data2=inv_sqrt_var, op=nl.multiply)
        
        # Copy result to output
